Name: core_i.id_stage_i.deassert_we
Attack Scenarios: A transient fault on core_i.id_stage_i.deassert_we can perturb CSR-operation suppression -> core_i.csr_op, producing an unintended value, enable, or transition at csr_we_int.
Justification: The CSR-write suppression control directly forces operations to READ; a fault can create or suppress an internal CSR write.
